bio.text: Stephanie Thomas has been Connecticut's Secretary of the State since January 4, 2023, and is the first Black person elected to the office; she is the Democratic nominee for re-election in 2026.
Before that she served a term as state representative for the 143rd District, representing Norwalk, Wilton and Westport.

According to the Secretary of the State's office, she was previously a nonprofit advisor and small business owner, and holds a B.A. from New York University and an M.S. in Nonprofit Management from The New School.
